description: This file defines a Bootstrap plugin for tab functionality, including a Tab class with methods to show and activate tabs, and a jQuery plugin interface. It manages tab switching behavior in a web UI.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a tab component with methods to show and activate tabs.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the selected tab, handling transition and event triggering.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a tab element, managing transition effects and updating classes.
